about_the_game:
Key Features:

  • Turn-based tactical missions

  • Unique agent management

  • Document analysis

  • Work with different types of disinformation

  • Variety of levels and challenges

  • Choice-driven narrative

Gameplay:

Before the Silence is a turn-based tactical strategy where you lead the Counter Disinformation Command, defending your nation and its citizens in the midst of an unfolding information war.

You operate from a central command panel — managing resources, monitoring threats, and neutralizing terrorist influence. One of your most important tools is intelligence analysis: review documents and media sources to detect disinformation and prevent its effects. Each paragraph could be truthful - or it could belong to one of several disinfo types. Be vigilant!

Your mission: restore order by reestablishing control over the information network and regaining influence across all regions of the country.

You act for the state… or for the people… or perhaps for no one at all.

The choice is yours.

Lore:

The game takes place in an alternate future, in a newly formed European country.

In 2056, a terrorist threat emerges within what remains of a democratic system, sparking an information war. A powerful group seizes control of media, spreads propaganda, and rewrites reality through a new order.

Who are they? What do they want? How do you stop them?

These are the questions you'll face as you play Before the Silence. And along the way - you might also question which side you’re really fighting for...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.4 GHz) / AMD FX
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / GTX 650 (1Gb VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required for Steam Cloud and updates

short_description: In this turn-based strategy, you will take control of an anti-disinformation department and protect your citizens from terrorist influence. Manage your agents and resources, analyze media, and restore order in different regions of your country.
supported_languages: English, Italian, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Ukrainian, Czech, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese
